description: Send a plain-text message to a channel or thread. For rich content (title, color, fields, images) use discord_send_embed; to attach a reply reference to an existing message use discord_reply_message. Requires the bot to have the Send Messages permission. Returns the new message ID.

channel_id.description: ID (snowflake) of the target channel or thread.

content.description: Plain-text body of the message (max 2000 characters).

name: discord_send_message
